evidence.observed: DE*MS1*E*MS*077*01*01 through sampled Bremer Platz EVSEs: 0.47 EUR/kWh AC
Business Ladekarte publishes separate contractual AC/DC energy and time components; retained as contract-channel evidence only, not ad-hoc pricing.

cpos.conclusion: Current station-level chargecloud-backed observations support 0.47 EUR/kWh on sampled DE*MS1 AC EVSEs, but no primary exhaustive direct-payment matrix was found. Keep fail-closed outside explicitly evidenced EVSEs; do not generalize the sampled 0.47 EUR/kWh to all DE*MS1 points.

evidence.observed: Ad-hoc charging is supported by QR code with PayPal or credit card; official page does not state the ad-hoc numeric tariff.
Stadtwerkedrive card tariff is 0.50 EUR/kWh AC/DC, with separate time rules; operator explicitly warns ad-hoc/fremdanbieter tariffs can differ.
DE*BOX*EAC0054 at Ostring 28: 0.51 EUR/kWh AC, no start fee, 0.10 EUR/min blocking fee after 240 min; page also exposes a 0.55 EUR/kWh HPC ad-hoc value at the site.

cpos.conclusion: DE*BOX is confirmed for Stadtwerke Bochum and exact direct-payment values exist at sampled EVSE/site scope. Because the official operator page explicitly distinguishes card and ad-hoc tariffs and does not publish an exhaustive direct matrix, retain only station/EVSE-scoped values and do not apply the 0.50 EUR/kWh card tariff network-wide to direct payment.
